verdict.rationale: Buzz has a workflows subsystem (CLI commands like `buzz workflows trigger/approve`, CI/patch/workflow-run integration) and vision text mentioning 'YAML-as-code automation,' showing event-triggered automation exists inside the chat tool. But this is explicitly YAML/CLI-driven, not a no-code builder, and there is no evidence of schedule-based or form-submission triggers or any drag-and-drop/no-code workflow designer for team-admins. Missing for 10: a documented no-code workflow builder UI, schedule-trigger support, form-submission trigger support, and admin-facing (non-CLI) workflow configuration.
